Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: mg_01649_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Read input: mg_01649_combined.v · Open raw
module mg_01649(input clk, input ce, input reset,input [15:0] prg_ain, output reg [21:0] prg_aout,input [13:0] chr_ain, output [21:0] chr_aout,input [3:0] mmc1_chr,input [21:0] mmc1_aout,output irq);
reg unlocked, old_val; 
  reg [29:0] counter; 
  reg [3:0] oldbits; 
  always @(posedge clk) if (reset) begin 
  old_val <= 0; 
  unlocked <= 0; 
  counter <= 0; 
  end else if (ce) begin 
  if (mmc1_chr[3] && !old_val) unlocked <= 1; 
  old_val <= mmc1_chr[3]; 
  counter <= mmc1_chr[3] ? 0 : counter + 1; 
  if (mmc1_chr != oldbits) begin 
  $write("NESEV Control Bits: %X => %X (%d)\n", oldbits, mmc1_chr, unlocked); 
  oldbits <= mmc1_chr; 
  end 
  end 
  assign irq = (counter[29:25] == 5'b10100); 
  always begin 
  if (!prg_ain[15]) begin 
  prg_aout = mmc1_aout; 
  end else if (!unlocked) begin 
  prg_aout = {7'b00_0000_0, prg_ain[14:0]}; 
  end else if (mmc1_chr[2] == 0) begin 
  prg_aout = {5'b00_000, mmc1_chr[1:0], prg_ain[14:0]}; 
  end else begin 
  prg_aout = mmc1_aout; 
  end 
  end 
  assign chr_aout = {9'b10_0000_000, chr_ain[12:0]}; 
 endmodule
